name: rukon-plugins
description: Claude Code plugins for Windows by rukon023: desktop notifications when Claude is done, a usage status line, and a usage limit guard

plugins.name: stop-notify
plugins.description: Windows notification with Claude's final message when the main session finishes and waits for you

plugins.name: usage-statusline
plugins.description: Status line with model, context usage, 5-hour and 7-day rate limit bars with reset times, folder and git branch

plugins.name: usage-guard
plugins.description: Stops Claude when the 5-hour or weekly usage limit reaches a threshold, warns every open session, and resumes stopped work when the 5-hour window resets
